objective: Build a zero-extra-spend, disabled-by-default reviewer bridge scaffold that can later use user-authorized ChatGPT-plan access to review exact PR SHAs automatically. The scaffold must be testable offline and must not perform live authorization or paid API calls.
constraints: USD 0 extra spend; no paid API fallback or API-key billing.
Do not implement or execute live authorization in this task; create only interfaces, disabled workflow scaffolding, docs, and offline tests.
Use gpt-6-astra only if a future user-authorized model catalog exposes that exact identifier; otherwise produce BLOCKED_NO_ASTRA.
Do not access or claim access to existing ChatGPT conversations or memory.
No local AI inference, no destructive PC actions, no merge or auto-merge.
Do not store or print authentication material; any future authorization state must remain host-local and outside the repository.
Reviewer is review-only: APPROVED or REJECTED; it must not implement fixes.
functional_requirements: Create a self-hosted-only reviewer workflow that is disabled/fails closed until a local authorization profile is available.
Create deterministic bridge logic for exact-model policy, exact-SHA review packet validation, CI evidence binding, verdict validation, blocked statuses, and idempotency.
Support statuses APPROVED, REJECTED, BLOCKED_AUTH_REQUIRED, BLOCKED_NO_ASTRA, and BLOCKED_PLAN_ALLOWANCE.
Create reviewer context files preserving zero-spend, no-local-inference, audit-only cleanup, bounded retries, and reviewer-only Astra rules.
A REJECTED verdict must deterministically map to a bounded correction package for the existing free-worker/controller loop.
An APPROVED verdict must bind to the exact reviewed SHA and must not merge.
Add offline regression tests using fakes for model catalog, approval, rejection, auth unavailable, allowance unavailable, SHA drift, malformed verdict, duplicate delivery, and secret-like input.
Regression must verify reviewer workflow is self-hosted-only and contains no API-key billing, merge/auto-merge, local inference, destructive cleanup, or conversation-scraping behavior.
Document the future one-time user authorization as a separate post-review setup step.
acceptance_criteria: All TASK-0003 tests run without network calls or credentials.
Exact gpt-6-astra is selected only from an explicitly supplied fake authorized catalog.
Missing Astra, missing authorization, or unavailable plan allowance returns a blocked state rather than using a substitute or paid fallback.
Exact-SHA mismatch fails before reviewer invocation.
REJECTED output creates a deterministic bounded correction package; APPROVED records exact-SHA approval only.
No authentication material or secret-like values are persisted in review history/evidence in tests.
Workflow is self-hosted-only and disabled until local authorization exists.
Review packet remains PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW and accurately describes offline scaffold status.
